def run(k,b,terms):
    g=1-np.exp(-k*t**b)
    basis={'1':np.ones_like(t),'g':g,'t':t,'gt':g*t}
    cols=[];nm_=[]
    for name in terms:
        T,pw=name
        cols.append(basis[T]*P**pw); nm_.append(name)
    X=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((dP_dt-X@c)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), c, nm_

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    s = np.tanh(params[0]*t**params[1])
    B = [np.ones_like(t), s, t, s*t]
    Pw = [np.ones_like(P), P, P**2, P**3, P**4]
    out = 0
    p = params[2:]
    # 4 basis x 5 powers = 20 coefficients; only first 8 params available so use a compact set
    terms = [B[0]*Pw[2], B[1]*Pw[0], B[1]*Pw[3], B[2]*Pw[1], B[3]*Pw[0], B[3]*Pw[1], B[0]*Pw[0], B[0]*Pw[1]]
    for i,tm in enumerate(terms):
        out = out + p[i]*tm
    return out
